../sources/princess-amber-actions-a-r3.w.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent 4-column by 2-row sprite grid for a children's party game
Primary request: Reproduce this exact Princess Amber character from the approved canonical reference. Make eight separate full-body animation key poses in row-major order:
Top row: (1) push, both palms braced forward at chest level, gown leaning into the push; (2) carry, careful walking hold with empty hands positioned to support an invisible object; (3) paint, poised hand as if brushing a separate surface, draw no brush or surface; (4) cast, elegant wand-casting posture with empty forward hand, draw no wand or magic.
Bottom row: (5) clap, joyful hands meeting at chest; (6) eat, gentle bite gesture with one empty hand near mouth, draw no food; (7) bow, graceful princess curtsy with one hand gathering the gown; (8) strike1, playful dramatic palm-forward self-defense pose with no weapon.
Subject: same long copper/auburn hair, amber star-flower crown, floor-length orange gown, black sleeves and bodice accents, white star/flower motifs outlined in black. Keep exact design, face, palette and body proportions.
Style/medium: bold smooth dark navy outlines, rounded appealing shapes, expressive eyes, bright clean colors, simple cel shading matching the 2D canonical.
Composition/framing: exactly eight cells in a clean four-column by two-row grid, one entire full-body Amber centered in each equal cell, generous transparent gutters, consistent head size, camera, line weight, and scale. Leave enough space for long hair and gown; no clipping.
Scene/backdrop: transparent.
Constraints: preserve Amber's exact identity and orange gown; hands remain natural human hands. Full character visible in every pose, no extra characters.
Avoid: dark backdrop, scenery, props, wand, food, brush, surface, shadows, floating stars or flowers, motion effects, text, border, watermark.
